description: Lifecycle hooks for project - Automates quality checks and security validation

security-check.description: Log file modification attempts for audit trail

prevent-dangerous-ops.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$VSCODE_TOOL_ARGS" == *"rm -rf /"* ]] || [[ "$VSCODE_TOOL_ARGS" == *"rm -rf /*"* ]]; then echo "❌ [SECURITY] Dangerous operation blocked"; exit 1; fi'

lint-check.description: Run focused ESLint after JS/TS file modifications

type-check.description: Run TypeScript check once after session completion

run-unit-tests.description: Run Vitest unit tests after session completion

git-status.description: Show modified files at session end
